description: What /metrics writes for a state of the daemon: each metric of api/metrics.json that has a sample, in that file's order, with its HELP and TYPE lines, then its samples by their label values in byte order. A value in seconds is written from integer nanoseconds, with nine digits after the point.

cases.note: a daemon just started: its first check measured the disk, no pass has ended, every counter at 0
cases.text:
# HELP atoll_build_info Always 1: the version Atoll was built as.
# TYPE atoll_build_info gauge
atoll_build_info{version="v0.1.0"} 1
# HELP atoll_disk_info Always 1: each disk of the configuration, its filesystem, its role and its mount path.
# TYPE atoll_disk_info gauge
atoll_disk_info{disk="t1",fs="ext4",role="data",mount="/mnt/t1"} 1
# HELP atoll_disk_state 1 for the state the disk is in, 0 for each other: online, standby, readonly, draining, missing or failed.
# TYPE atoll_disk_state gauge
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="draining"} 0
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="failed"} 0
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="missing"} 0
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="online"} 1
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="readonly"} 0
atoll_disk_state{disk="t1",state="standby"} 0
# HELP atoll_disk_capacity_bytes The disk's size, as a mount check last measured it.
# TYPE atoll_disk_capacity_bytes gauge
atoll_disk_capacity_bytes{disk="t1"} 1000
# HELP atoll_disk_free_bytes The bytes the disk has free, as a mount check last measured them.
# TYPE atoll_disk_free_bytes gauge
atoll_disk_free_bytes{disk="t1"} 400
# HELP atoll_passes_total The passes that ended since the daemon started.
# TYPE atoll_passes_total counter
atoll_passes_total 0
# HELP atoll_pass_failures_total The passes that failed since the daemon started.
# TYPE atoll_pass_failures_total counter
atoll_pass_failures_total 0
# HELP atoll_copied_bytes_total The bytes of the replicas the passes made since the daemon started, those of the files on the SSD cache among them.
# TYPE atoll_copied_bytes_total counter
atoll_copied_bytes_total 0
# HELP atoll_disk_standby 1 when the disk's last mount check found it asleep.
# TYPE atoll_disk_standby gauge
atoll_disk_standby{disk="t1"} 0
# HELP atoll_scrub_read_copies_total The copies the scrub read whole on the disk and found as their hashes say, since the daemon started.
# TYPE atoll_scrub_read_copies_total counter
atoll_scrub_read_copies_total{disk="t1"} 0
# HELP atoll_scrub_read_bytes_total The bytes of those copies.
# TYPE atoll_scrub_read_bytes_total counter
atoll_scrub_read_bytes_total{disk="t1"} 0
# HELP atoll_scrub_corrupt_total The copies the scrub found corrupt on the disk since the daemon started.
# TYPE atoll_scrub_corrupt_total counter
atoll_scrub_corrupt_total{disk="t1"} 0
